harness_rollout_evidence.question: can the selected headless run swap to the internal Unified Harness without any Swallowtail-visible argv change
harness_rollout_evidence.pypi_channel: mistralai_vibe_local_harness is absent from every official wheel and sdist, so experimental_harness_available() is false and the rollout branch can never fire
harness_rollout_evidence.github_zip_channel: the bundled native module appears from 2.25.1; with an ambient ~/.vibe experiment eval cache resolving variant unified, resolve_harness_selection would pick the unified backend for the selected argv
harness_rollout_evidence.resolution: the adapter-privately selected --legacy-harness flag has first-precedence in resolve_harness_selection and pins the legacy Python harness deterministically on both channels; the unified backend stays unmapped
harness_rollout_evidence.native_backend_authority: the bundled backend is a native module whose tool-authority behavior is not statically classifiable; execution remains forbidden, so it is excluded on the selected route rather than mapped
